text.en: No rule forbids pets on a space station, so a spacer named Sven Olsen brings a small bird with him to work among the stars.

The narrator says no regulation forbade keeping pets in a space station, and even if it had, Sven Olsen would have ignored it.
Sven was a wiry little fellow, like most early spacers, and easily met the weight limit for the bonus.
The work was assembling girders and fusing parts of the station together in space suits, a skilled and difficult job.
Sven's team had a special advantage, and the story builds around his pet bird.
This is a science fiction story because it imagines space stations and life in space.
The title asks who a feathered friend can be, and shows that pets can be friends and helpers.
Science fiction mixes real science, like weightlessness, with imagination.
Words: wiry means thin but strong, assorted means various, and garb means clothing.
The story is told by an ordinary spacer, a first-person narrator.
Think about why a bird would behave differently in space.
